methodology.scope: hot-cache repeated fixed-input CUDA Graph device-region latency
methodology.capture: 64 independent fixed-input invocations per graph, side-stream binding and capture, five warmup replays
methodology.timing: CUDA event milliseconds per full graph replay divided by 64; no Python between captured invocations
methodology.comparison: custom optimized and PyTorch eager captured identically; eager host allocations become fixed graph-pool storage
methodology.limitations: Inputs and buffers are reused; hot caches and CUDA Graph scheduling differ from production dispatch. Replay overhead is amortized, not assumed zero. Complements full runtime measurements; no hardware bandwidth/utilization counters.

metrics.interpretation: algorithmic work divided by measured latency; not measured DRAM bandwidth, utilization or hardware counters
